description: This file implements the AWCContainerAdministrator class, which manages container instances, including creation, configuration, and listener management, within a process container framework. It also defines the PluginConfig class for parsing configuration parameters.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: Configuration parser class for container plugin settings, including proxy usage and timeouts.

classes.name: AWCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages AWC container instances, including creation, configuration, and listener setup.

methods.description: Constructor that parses configuration string and sets parameters.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container administrator and sets up the AWC client and listener.

methods.description: Destructor that removes the listener from the AWC client.
